heading: Modern Presentation Layer for
swecha.org
hero.subheading: A high-performance, decoupled frontend architecture engineered with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and daisyUI. Designed for optimal load speeds, structural localization stability, and visual premium interfaces.

cards.title: Island Architecture
cards.desc: Zero client-side JavaScript by default, hydrating interactive blocks only when needed for peak performance.

cards.title: Multilingual Routing
cards.desc: Integrated localization engines mapped to locale subdirectory routes for seamless user access.

cards.title: Responsive Specs
cards.desc: Structured breakpoints ensuring clean interface delivery on mobile devices, tablets, and wide monitors.

about.title: About Swecha
about.subtitle: Driven by free software values, we build technologies to empower communities.

pillars.title: Mission
pillars.detail: Bridging the digital divide by providing localized GNU/Linux solutions and global software tools to local users.

pillars.title: Origins
pillars.detail: Founded to support the Swecha project, we are a vibrant collective of developers, students, and academicians dedicated to the free software model.

pillars.title: Technical
pillars.detail: Overcoming technical barriers by developing GPL-licensed Telugu fonts and collaborating globally with the FontForge community.

pillars.title: Impact
pillars.detail: By standardizing technical terminology through community feedback and collaborative translation, we successfully launched the localized GNU/Linux version in 2005.
